# `<dev/protocols/mbox.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

VideoCore property-mailbox protocol ("/svc/mbox").

mboxdrv owns the BCM2711 mailbox and runs one property tag per request. Requests and replies travel in the message buffer.

```c
#include <dev/protocols/mbox.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="mbox_service"></a>`MBOX_SERVICE` | `"/svc/mbox"` | Service path of the mailbox driver. |
| <a id="mbox_cmd_property"></a>`MBOX_CMD_PROPERTY` | `1` | Run one property tag. [MboxRequest](#mboxrequest) in, [MboxReply](#mboxreply) out. |
| <a id="mbox_value_max"></a>`MBOX_VALUE_MAX` | `256u` | Largest tag value buffer, in bytes. |
| <a id="mbox_tag_get_mac"></a>`MBOX_TAG_GET_MAC` | `0x00010003u` | Property tag: board MAC address, 6 bytes in wire order. |
| <a id="mbox_tag_get_serial"></a>`MBOX_TAG_GET_SERIAL` | `0x00010004u` | Property tag: board serial number, 8 bytes. |
| <a id="mbox_tag_get_fw_rev"></a>`MBOX_TAG_GET_FW_REV` | `0x00000001u` | Property tag: firmware revision, 4 bytes. |
| <a id="mbox_tag_get_board_rev"></a>`MBOX_TAG_GET_BOARD_REV` | `0x00010002u` | Property tag: board revision, 4 bytes. |

## Structures

### `MboxRequest` { #mboxrequest }

A request, in the message buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | MBOX_CMD_PROPERTY. |

| `req_len` | `uint32_t` | Bytes of `value` sent to the firmware. |
